justifications.durability: the four added refusal tests are verified by reinstating the regression: the base arm runs the head test file against the base modules and both census tests redden there (baseline-suite-revised.log), and negative-control-revised.log disables only the geometric membership clause at plot.py:239 and shows test_census_geometry_is_checked_even_when_flag_is_checked redden while the independent flag test stays green.
justifications.evidence: the gate is the done_when: after-suite-revised.log runs both efit_axis_adjudication test files and reports completed=true failure_count=0 while baseline-suite-revised.log reports failure_count=5 over the same files, receipt-audit-revised.log binds the page's counts to the receipt fields (RECEIPT_SUMMARY rows=26 compared=18 stress=8 in_vessel=184 figures=9), and render-inspection.log carries nine INSPECTED lines matching the manifest's byte figures.

justifications.scope_discipline: every path in git diff --name-only 850f8adcc 371f96f3f lies inside the six paths enumerated at prompt.txt:88-94, and the manifest's changed_paths omits only the deleted efit-axis-jt60sa.svg rather than adding anything out of scope.
